title: Prepayment and Account Transfer Table for Medical Records Requests
content:
For each Medical Records Requests type, two figures govern when a records fee is settled: whether the fee must be paid before the records are released, and the number of calendar days after fulfillment after which an unpaid fee moves to the patient's financial account. A transfer figure of 0 means the fee is never transferred.

| Request type | Fee paid before release | Transfer period after fulfillment (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| Portal Self-Service Download | No | 0 (never transferred) |
| Patient Electronic Copy Request | No | 30 |
| Patient Paper Copy Request | No | 30 |
| Provider-to-Provider Transfer | No | 0 (never transferred) |
| Third-Party Authorized Release | Yes | 0 (never transferred) |
| Certified Legal Records Package | Yes | 0 (never transferred) |
| Imaging Disc Copy Request | No | 30 |

## Reading the table

- The two types that require payment before release, the Third-Party Authorized Release and the Certified Legal Records Package, both show a transfer period of 0, so an unpaid fee on either of them never moves to the patient's financial account.
- The three types with a 30-day transfer period — the Patient Electronic Copy Request, the Patient Paper Copy Request and the Imaging Disc Copy Request — are types on which payment before release is not required.
- The Portal Self-Service Download and the Provider-to-Provider Transfer require no payment before release and show no transfer period.
